received_works.body:
Hello 澤谷さん！ I really like your illustrations of beautiful maid girls and want to request a drawing of my OC.

She looks like a normal cute girl but in fact she is a underground mercenary who will fight bad guys with her pistol at night. Therefore her characteristics is not very cute: she is unfriendly and aggressive and will become cocky easily which put her in trouble sometimes.

If you don't mind, can you please draw her in a maid outfit? You can design the maid dress in any way you like. And please decide the detail of the illustrations according to your preference! Thank you!

--------------------
